notes: REF-BM-02: metadata parser collects title, favicon(icon), and preview image, but never a description (no description field exists in the model). REF-BM-03: title is editable before/after save, but there is no description to edit. REF-BM-04: url/title/tags/note editable via edit form, but no description field. REF-BM-07: card exposes title, tags, domain, and preview image, but not a description (none) and not the favicon (only preview image or host initial shown). REF-BM-08: selecting a list item links to the internal detail page (/bookmarks/:id), not the original url; the original is only reachable via a secondary 'Open page' link on the detail page. REF-BM-10: TagEditor is a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete/datalist; the /tags list endpoint exists but is not wired into tag entry. REF-BM-12: full-text search covers title, url, note, and tags but not description (field absent). REF-BM-15: implicit AND, OR, and NOT operators work and operators can be quoted as literals, but parenthesised groups are explicitly rejected (parser throws 'Grouping with parentheses is not supported yet'). REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions; actions are per-bookmark only. REF-BM-21: no bulk-apply-to-filtered-collection capability. REF-BM-24: no page snapshot (HTML) or PDF download/storage. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no saved bundle/filter entity or endpoint. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: no user-settings entity, endpoint, or UI; sort is transient session state only (no persisted default sort, items-per-page, or font size).
